description: MSCHALLENGE 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：病灶负荷统计；纵向病灶变化；mschallenge 质控汇总；mschallenge 数据校验；FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）；FreeSurfer recon-all（可执行）。

method_refs.label: 病灶负荷统计
method_refs.role: Analyze lesion masks from MS Lesion Challenge data. Computes lesion volume, count, and location statistics from binary lesion masks。 Inputs: input: 病灶影像目录 (directory). Registered outputs: results/lesions.csv.

method_refs.label: 纵向病灶变化
method_refs.role: Analyze longitudinal lesion changes across timepoints. Tracks lesion volume, count, and new/enlarged/resolved lesions across multiple timepoints for each subject。 Inputs: input: 病灶影像目录 (directory). Registered outputs: results/lesions.csv.

method_refs.label: mschallenge 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries for MS Challenge processing. Checks modality completeness, ground truth presence, and data quality。 Inputs: input: Path to MS Challenge directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: mschallenge 数据校验
method_refs.role: Validate MS Lesion Challenge directory structure. Checks directory structure, modality completeness, ground truth presence, and longitudinal timepoint consistency。 Inputs: input: Path to MS Challenge directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）

execution_resolution.reason: 选择原文委托的具体结构处理入口；不同流程分别列出，按用户所需范围执行。

method_refs.role: Invoke the existing FSL fsl_anat workflow on a T1-weighted image and retain its structural.anat directory, including the bias-corrected brain image。 Inputs: input: T1w NIfTI (file). Registered outputs: results/structural.anat/T1_biascorr_brain.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation fsl-anat.

pipeline_refs.label: FreeSurfer recon-all（可执行）
pipeline_refs.default_reason: 当用户明确要求 FreeSurfer 分割/皮层重建且已提供 T1w 时，选择服务器已验证的 recon-all Runner。

execution_resolution.reason: 选择原文委托的具体结构处理入口；不同流程分别列出，按用户所需范围执行。

pipeline_refs.role: 依次执行：FreeSurfer recon-all（可执行）。输入和参数由方法契约定义。

selection_rules: 单次病灶负荷选择病灶统计；纵向变化选择同一受试者跨时点的病灶比较，并明确是否具有 ground truth。
name: mschallenge-skill
